corePricing.entryExitBody: Prices for entering and exiting the trade plus optional stop-loss and take-profit anchors.
corePricing.directionMarketBody: Whether the position is LONG or SHORT and the instrument type (stock, forex, crypto, etc.).
corePricing.statusBody: OPEN or CLOSED. OpenedAt marks when the position opened; ClosedAt is set when it closes.
corePricing.capitalUsedBody: Cash or margin allocated to this trade.

pnlAndRisk.feesCostsBody: All trading costs deducted from gross P&L.
pnlAndRisk.pnlGrossBody: Signed price delta × quantity before costs. Futures and similar contracts also apply the contract multiplier or point value (for example MNQ uses $2 per point, or $0.50 per 0.25 tick).
pnlAndRisk.pnlNetBody: P&L gross minus fees, commission, and slippage. Risk amount only affects R-multiple; it does not change net P&L.
pnlAndRisk.pnlPercentBody: Net P&L divided by capital used, expressed as a percentage. Risk amount does not change net P&L or replace this denominator.
pnlAndRisk.riskAmountPercentBody: Risk amount is the cash you are willing to lose if the stop-loss is hit. Risk % is risk amount divided by capital used when capital used is available.
pnlAndRisk.rMultipleBody: Net P&L divided by risk amount. If risk amount is blank, R multiple stays blank. 1R equals the initial cash risk.

EXACT_MATCH.label: Exact match
EXACT_MATCH.description: Synchronize closed live trades when strategy, instrument, and any configured session or timeframe match.

STRATEGY_MATCH.label: Strategy match
STRATEGY_MATCH.description: Synchronize every closed live trade linked to this strategy.

REVIEW_BEFORE_IMPORT.label: Review before import
REVIEW_BEFORE_IMPORT.description: Send eligible live trades to the Research Inbox for confirmation.

DISABLED.label: Disabled
DISABLED.description: Do not synchronize new live trades; existing evidence remains intact.

filters.title: Trade filters
filters.searchTrades: Search trades, setups, tags, or notes

INSUFFICIENT_DATA.label: Insufficient data
INSUFFICIENT_DATA.description: Fewer than 5 completed trades; no edge conclusion is supported.

EXPLORATORY.label: Exploratory
EXPLORATORY.description: 5–9 completed trades; use findings only to guide further testing.

EARLY_SIGNAL.label: Early signal
EARLY_SIGNAL.description: 10–29 completed trades; a signal may exist but remains sensitive to variance.

DEVELOPING_EDGE.label: Developing edge
DEVELOPING_EDGE.description: 30–49 completed trades with enough evidence for cautious comparison.

VALIDATED_EVIDENCE.label: Validated evidence
VALIDATED_EVIDENCE.description: At least 50 completed trades with non-negative expectancy and no material review flags.

NEEDS_REVIEW.label: Needs review
NEEDS_REVIEW.description: Negative expectancy, unresolved evidence, or material live/historical divergence needs attention.

VERY_LOW.label: Very low
VERY_LOW.description: The sample or classification coverage is too limited for confident conclusions.

LOW.label: Low
LOW.description: Some evidence exists, but source diversity or sample quality is limited.

MODERATE.label: Moderate
MODERATE.description: The sample, source diversity, and consistency support cautious conclusions.

HIGH.label: High
HIGH.description: A broad, classified sample shows stable and consistent evidence across sources.
